known_pitfall_claim: The equality in lines 26–27 is false because it replaces dx with d(nx) while retaining the prefactor n.
pitfall_counterexample: Take real parameters n=1, a=0, b=1, interpreting d(nx)=n dx. No other hypotheses are stated. Then both sides are ∫₀¹ [1/(π(1+x²))] dx = (arctan 1−arctan 0)/π = 1/4. Thus the unqualified assertion that the equality is false has an explicit counterexample.
